signals.summary: A late-August wave of recipe roundups built on peak end-of-summer produce: tomatoes, corn, peaches, berries, brie, and chilled dishes. Squarely visual, plated-food content keyed to the season.
signals.why_now: Nine independent outlets converge on the same seasonal peak within days-to-weeks: BuzzFeed's 'End-Of-Summer Produce' (~525h), Allrecipes cucumber-tomato salad 'for August' (~237h), Simply Recipes '27 Tomato Recipes' (~453h), plus Food & Wine summer salad, summer vegetable, summer fruit, summer soup and summer dessert roundups. Seasonal exemption applies.

signals.summary: A sustained push of high-protein products framed as the summer's defining food trend, from protein ice cream to protein/fiber baked goods and snack bars. All illustrable as tangible food objects.
signals.why_now: Multiple independent trade and consumer outlets carry it across the pass: Forbes 'Protein Ice Cream Is This Summer's Next Food Trend', Baking Business 'Protein, fiber battle for top food trend', Commercial Baking on the snack-bar trend, and NOW Toronto plus Godrej's 2026 report echoing 'savoury protein'. Broad and cross-source rather than a single spike.

signals.summary: The polka-dot / Funfetti 'dot cake' baking meme spreading on TikTok and Instagram, a highly photogenic decorated-cake format ideal for still and short-video food content.
signals.why_now: Three independent outlets carry the same named meme: USA Today's how-to on 'the internet's favorite dot cake trend', NEWS10's local micro-bakery 'brings viral dot cake trend to area', and the BBC forecasting 'dot cakes to trend on TikTok and Instagram in summer'. Aging but still summer-live and coherent across sources.

signals.summary: Renewed momentum around regional Mexican food, both as an evolving retail/flavour trend and a wave of new casual-Mexican restaurant concepts. Plated tacos, cantina dishes and produce photograph well.
signals.why_now: Speciality Food Magazine reports 'the Mexican food trend has evolved', while two fresh openings land within a day: Dallas' casual Mexican Fonda Toro (~13h) and Tarpon Springs' Catalina's La Cantina (~13h). Trend commentary plus multiple independent new concepts.

signals.summary: A sustained tilt toward bold spicy and 'chatpata' (tangy-spicy) flavours as a defining direction in 2026 food. Illustrable through chilies, spice-forward dishes and vivid saucing.
signals.why_now: Three independent outlets frame it as an ongoing shift: Taste of Home's 'Why Spicy Food Is Everywhere Right Now', Times of India on 'Chatpata flavours' leading 2026 trends, and Godrej's Food Trends Report 2026 headlining 'Chatpata Flavours'. Cross-source and cross-market rather than a single burst.
